item.title: Building Digital Capabilities for Improved ESG Performance of Entrepreneurial Firms: Strategies for Tackling Challenges and Capitalizing on Opportunities
item.content:encoded:
Stefano Bresciani, University of Torino

Jawad Abbas, James Cook University

Fauzia Jabeen, Abu Dhabi University

The collection addresses how entrepreneurial firms develop digital capabilities to enhance their Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance. With technological advancements reshaping business landscapes, entrepreneurial ventures must integrate digital solutions while meeting stakeholder expectations for sustainable and ethical practices.

The collection seeks empirical, conceptual, and theoretical studies exploring the intersection of digital capabilities and ESG outcomes in entrepreneurial firms. It examines how digital transformation contributes to environmental responsibility, social sustainability, and governance structures, while investigating challenges and opportunities in this convergence.

Papers should address how firms define ESG performance digitally, manage sustainability challenges, leverage technology for transparency, and balance profitability with sustainable practices. The editors welcome innovative methodological approaches and case studies demonstrating the impact of digital capabilities on ESG performance.

Potential topics

  • Digital capabilities and ESG performance
  • Environmental sustainability and digital solutions
  • Digital technologies for ESG measurement
  • Leadership and organizational culture in digital transformation
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion through digital capabilities
  • Governance structures and digitalization
  • Regulatory frameworks and ESG compliance
  • Transparency and accountability in ESG reporting
  • Profitability and sustainable practices balance
  • Real-world case studies of digital capabilities impact
  • Knowledge-sharing and learning mechanisms in entrepreneurial ecosystems

item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, University of Campania Luigi Vanvitelli

This multi-journal collection brings together research on entrepreneurship as a catalyst for addressing significant global challenges. It examines how entrepreneurial activities create expected and realized changes, analyzing their implications at individual, organizational, and systemic levels.

The collection welcomes papers investigating entrepreneurship's impact on shaping the future through diverse analytical perspectives. It targets researchers, practitioners, and policymakers interested in understanding entrepreneurship's role in contemporary and emerging social, environmental, and economic contexts.
